apps.localizedDescription: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on iPhone and iPad - no jailbreak. Madeira bundles FEX-Emu, Wine, and DXMT, and puts your GOG, Epic Games, EA app, and itch.io libraries in one place: sign in, download, and play. Requires iOS 18 or later. The IPA links straight to the official willfaust/Madeira GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on iOS

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a GOG section (sign in, library, downloads, Galaxy achievements and stats), an EA app section (library and downloads), and itch.io support. Epic Games downloads and cloud saves now work together. New store tabs when more than one store is enabled.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio's official app: movies, series, live TV and add-ons in one place. These are Stremio's own builds, mirrored from their CDN (dl.strem.io) to GitHub so this repo can track them - the 2.1.1 (build 25) files were verified byte-identical to Stremio's official copies.
apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Freedom to stream

apps.localizedDescription: A native iOS content hub. The IPA links straight to the official DjangoCustard225/Vesper GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically. Requires iOS 27.
apps.name: Vesper
apps.subtitle: Native iOS content hub

versions.localizedDescription:
- Introduced widgets for Continue Watching, Up Next and your Library. Tapping a poster or title opens the stream, and posters keep their colours in Clear mode.
- New app icon.
- Cleaned up the API entry pages. Each sheet has a checkmark that saves and verifies your key.
- iCloud sync for your library and add-ons. Add-ons that arrive through sync ask for your approval first.
- Plain HTTP add-ons show a warning before install.
- Faster launch, with your library and watch progress loading in the background.
- Sheets close with the native Liquid Glass cross, and scroll bars are hidden throughout...

- Faster Usenet streaming, with quicker starts and fewer stalls.
- Actor pages now show birthplace, dates, aliases and a full biography in a sheet, with links to IMDb, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube and their website.
- Added a search field to the source picker.
- Settings now show whether SubDL, Usenet and add-ons are connected.
- Your SubDL key is checked when you save it, and you can remove it.
- Playback pauses for calls and Siri and resumes afterwards.
- Smoother scrolling and playback, and clearer error messages.

apps.localizedDescription: Playport runs Windows games - 64-bit and 32-bit - on a stock, non-jailbroken iPhone: install a game from your library, pick up a controller, and play. The game runs on the phone's own CPU and GPU - no PC, no cloud, no streaming. The IPA links straight to the official playportdev/playport GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Playport
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iOS

apps.localizedDescription: A free, open-source on-device app manager and installer for iPhone and iPad. Import your signing certificate (P12 + provisioning profile) and Feather signs and installs apps right on the device - no computer needed. It browses AltStore-format sources, including this one, so your shelves work in Feather too. The IPA links straight to the official khcrysalis/Feather GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device app manager & signer

apps.localizedDescription: An all-in-one retro game emulator for iOS, packing many systems - including Nintendo, 3DS and Wii cores - into one clean app. This is the project's Sideload JIT build from their official GitHub releases. The IPA links straight to the official Manic-EMU/ManicEMU release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Manic EMU
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro emulator

versions.localizedDescription: Improved 3DS performance, Azahar core and Home Menu improvements, Wii pointer fixes, and more.

apps.localizedDescription: The official iOS port of the Dolphin emulator: GameCube and Wii games on iPhone and iPad. These are the project's current public beta builds (the 5.0.0 line) in the Non-Jailbroken flavor, linked straight from the official OatmealDome/dolphin-ios GitHub releases, and this repo tracks new releases automatically. Full speed needs JIT, which a JIT enabler app can provide.
apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.subtitle: GameCube & Wii emulator

versions.localizedDescription: Public beta 6 - adds JIT support on iOS 26.6 and iOS 27 beta, per the project's changelog.

apps.localizedDescription: MovieBox Pro's official iOS app for movies and TV streaming. The project distributes the IPA from its own site (movieboxpro.app) rather than GitHub; this repo tracks the site's current build automatically, and each entry links to that version's file on their CDN. There is no Apple TV version - their TV app is for Android TV only.
apps.name: MovieBoxPro
apps.subtitle: Movies & TV streaming

apps.localizedDescription: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.
apps.name: Nuvio Enhanced
apps.subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

It keeps the stock YouTube bundle ID, so it installs as the YouTube app itself. Requires iOS 17+.

apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is a multi-system retro emulator for iPhone and iPad covering 60+ systems — Nintendo, Sega, Atari, Sony and more — with iCloud sync for ROMs, saves and artwork, RetroAchievements, controller skins and video filters. Open source by the Provenance team; builds link straight to their official GitHub releases.
apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro emulator — 60+ systems

versions.localizedDescription: 3.3.0: iCloud/CloudKit sync for ROMs, save states, BIOS files and artwork; a completely redesigned tvOS interface; a unified video filter and shader pipeline across cores; RetroArch GLES 3D core support; and a long list of core, controller and stability fixes.

apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug is an on-device JIT enabler and debugger for sideloaded apps on iOS 17.4 and later — it's what lets emulators like Manic EMU and DolphiniOS run at full speed without a computer attached. One-time setup needs a device pairing file and a loopback VPN (LocalDevVPN); on iOS 26 and later it uses its script-based JIT path.
apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and device toolbox

versions.localizedDescription: 3.2.2: fixes for the Utsuro, Henge and MeloCafe JIT scripts.

apps.localizedDescription: The stock Twitch app with the TwitchAdBlock mod baked in — ads blocked on live streams and VODs, including pre-rolls, mid-rolls, feed banners and sponsor spots. It keeps the stock tv.twitch bundle ID, so it installs in place of the official Twitch app rather than alongside it.
apps.name: TwitchAdBlock
apps.subtitle: Twitch with ads blocked

versions.localizedDescription:
What's New

Updated for Twitch 32.2.

Fixed the chat box disappearing. While typing a longer message, the chat box could go blank above the keyboard for a moment, mostly when your channel points button was showing your points total. It now stays visible.

Fixed channels wrongly blocked for your region. Some channels showed "Due to your age and/or region, you cannot access this content" (for example ones labelled Gambling) or said they were restricted in your country, even though they work for you normally. Content restrictions are now based on your own location, so these channels open just...

What's New

Wide emotes at full size. With Keep Wide Emote Shape on (Settings → Emotes, on by default), wide 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes now show at the same height as normal emotes, and the chat line makes room for them so nothing overlaps.

Much faster emotes. Third-party emotes now show up almost instantly, even in busy chats. Each channel's emote list is remembered between launches, emote images load from a smaller format, and each image is only prepared once.

Fixed emotes showing as plain text. If two channels used the same name for different emotes, the second channel's emote could show as...
Twitch 31.9 with TwitchAdBlock mod 0.1.21 (full build, app extensions included).

apps.localizedDescription: Husk runs Android apps and games — and PlayStation 4 fake packages and game folders — right on your iPhone. Its translation layer runs games built with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Flutter, SDL and more natively, and a full Android system is there for everything else. Games need JIT: enable it with StikDebug (already on this shelf), its built-in StikJIT, or the Play without JIT flow after importing your certificate.
apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android apps and PS4 games on your iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 3.4 (build 149).

apps.localizedDescription: Henge runs macOS on iPhone and iPad with its own emulator — it downloads Apple's restore image and installs macOS right on the device, no Mac needed. Safari and Discord run, and the clipboard and a shared folder work between macOS and iOS. It is emulation, so it runs slower than a real Mac. Needs JIT (StikDebug works), iOS 17 or later, an A14 or M1 chip or newer, and about 43 GB free for the macOS install.
apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on your iPhone and iPad.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.3.0 (build 101). Adds macOS Sonoma 14.6.1 and Ventura 13.6 installs — smaller downloads for devices short on storage.

apps.localizedDescription: Utsuro runs Xbox One games on iPhone and iPad. It is an alpha: Minecraft: Xbox One Edition, Rocket League and Sonic Mania are confirmed starting, everything else is unconfirmed and bugs are expected. You import your own Xbox One game dumps. Needs JIT (StikDebug, already on this shelf).
apps.name: Utsuro
apps.subtitle: Alpha — Xbox One games on iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.1.0 (build 1).

apps.localizedDescription: AetherPS4 is Levi's standalone PlayStation 4 emulator for iPhone and iPad — the dedicated app and emulator core, separate from Husk's built-in PS4 layer. PS4 emulation on a phone is early days, so expect limited compatibility. Needs JIT (StikDebug, already on this shelf).
apps.name: AetherPS4
apps.subtitle: PS4 emulator for iPhone and iPad.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 1.2.0 (build 12).

apps.localizedDescription: Podium emulates a classic iPod Touch — it currently targets iOS 6.1.6 on the 4th-generation iPod Touch; other devices and software versions can be tried but will probably fail. For JIT, the developer says to use universal.js in StikDebug (already on this shelf).
apps.name: Podium
apps.subtitle: A classic iPod Touch on a modern iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.1.0 (build 10).

apps.localizedDescription: Fathom is an x86-64 PC emulator for iPhone, running guest code through FEXCore. 2048 and tic-tac-toe ship as sample programs you can add from the Library tab. Needs JIT via StikDebug (already on this shelf).
apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: An x86-64 PC emulator for iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 1.0.0 (build 1).

apps.localizedDescription: Sora is a modular media player for iOS (this build's app bundle is named Sulfur) — a clean, ad-free player with no library of its own. Movies, shows and anime come from community modules you add yourself. It supports HLS and MP4, background playback and picture-in-picture, AniList sync, and offline watching through modules. Free and open source (GPLv3). Heads-up: no modules are included — you supply your own — and the GitHub repo is now archived, so 1.3.0 may be the final build.
apps.name: Sora
apps.subtitle: Modular streaming player — bring your own modules

versions.localizedDescription: What's New: Modules Settings support; AniList sync (Watching/Planing collections). Fixes: search results being randomized; bookmark removal causing the view to close; 'Mark as Watched' option not showing; 'Watch Next' button choosing the wrong season.

apps.localizedDescription: Halo: Combat Evolved running natively on iPhone and iPad — a port of the Halo decompilation projects, compiled for ARM64 with OpenGL ES 3 graphics, SDL audio and on-screen touch controls. No game data is included: open the app, tap Choose Halo XISO, and import your own disc image from the original Xbox release (NTSC-US or PAL). The app extracts the maps on-device, then the game starts. Still early — expect the odd bug.
apps.name: Halo: CE
apps.subtitle: The original Xbox Halo, native on iOS

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.1.2 (build 6). Renders at native display resolution by default, with landscape gameplay and importing. Optional lower render resolution via the [display] section of Documents/config.toml.
